title: Customer Visible Origin
description: Fulfillment origin that may be rendered to the buyer because it is customer visible, such as a retail store.

visibility.description: Indicates this origin can be rendered to the buyer.

origin_type.description: Origin type. Well-known values: retail_location, store, locker, pickup_point. Businesses MAY define additional values using reverse-domain naming.

location.description: Buyer-visible location details for this origin.

description.description: Buyer-facing description of the origin, such as 'Ships from your local store'.
